criteria.requirement: Repair Traceback.extract for the entire cause/context/ExceptionGroup graph using exception object identity IDs, not hashing or equality/text. Each exception appears at most once, self/multi-object cycles terminate, shared group members and unhashable custom exceptions work, normal chain order/is_cause/__suppress_context__ remain correct and notes belong to the actual current exception rather than being copied from the first. Propagate the same visited set through group recursion without prematurely marking unprocessed children. Preserve normal frame extraction/rendering and control test baseline cycles in a bounded subprocess so regression cannot hang indefinitely.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
